india5.title: HT Morning News Brief October 11: SC special sitting today on Delhi curbs; Naseeruddin Shah to portray Rushdie
india5.description: Here are the top headlines from the day that you need to know - from politics and world news to sports and entertainment.

india5.title: Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka kept under preventive arrest ahead of fresh Jantar Mantar stir
india5.description: The CJP leaders were taken into custody from inside a flight after it landed at the Delhi airport. They will be produced before the executive magistrate.

india5.title: Former Madhya Pradesh health officer booked over fake MBBS degree after 16 years
india5.description: Sunil Singh was removed from his post after a health department inquiry found his degree fraudulent. Police registered a case on Saturday.

india5.title: Mahatma Gandhi's great-grandson Tushar Gandhi, Oppn leaders, actors among detainees across India
india5.description: Demonstrations and detentions were also reported in Bengaluru, Chennai, Jaipur and Chandigarh; Goa protesters held a rally.

india5.title: Farmers stopped at Noida-Delhi border amid CJP protest
india5.description: BKU-affiliated farmers travelled in tractors and trolleys following a call by Rakesh Tikait and later staged a sit-in at the toll plaza.

india5.title: Delhi Metro stations open today, trains running on schedule after day of closure
india5.description: The restrictions came into effect at 9 pm on Friday as a security measure ahead of the CJP’s planned demonstration at Jantar Mantar.

india5.title: After CJP, Opposition calls for protest, march to Supreme Court to demand action against SIR
india5.description: Opposition leaders accuse the government of suppressing dissent and are demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.

india5.title: SIT probing BKTC donation theft case names 3 in charge sheet
india5.description: The Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the alleged theft of donations at the Badrinath shrine in Uttarakhand’s Chamoli district has submitted a charge sheet naming three accused, including suspended Badrinath-Kedarnath Temple Commitee (BKTC) employee Pramod Nautiyal, at a local court

india6.title: PM Modi in Tamil Nadu LIVE | Prime Minister, CM Vijay inaugurate Chennai Metro Rail's Phase 2 stretch
india6.description: Six years after the work began, Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL)’s first train ran from Porur Bypass at noon on October 11, 2026, with Mr. Modi and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay being the first few commuters.

india6.title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE updates: Supreme Court directs authorities to ensure free movement in Delhi, bars illegal detentions
india6.description: Dipke, Das and Ranka released on condition of 'no breach of peace for one year'; The CJP has called for another round of 'Chalo Jantar Mantar' protest today

india6.title: Osmania junior doctors to protest on October 12 over training, working conditions
india6.description: According to an official strike notice issued on October 10, the protest will begin at 8.30 a.m. at the main gate of Osmania General Hospital

india6.title: Delhi braces for CJP protest: 45 metro stations shut, trains cancelled, 23,000 security personnel deployed
india6.description: Here is everything you need to know about the massive security lockdown in Delhi ahead of the CJP’s October 10 protest.

india6.title: Delhi protest: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released from detention, alleges ‘kidnapping’
india6.description: The detention came amid an unprecedented security clampdown in Delhi, where more than 7,000 protesters were detained at multiple locations, police sources said

india6.title: CJP 'B-Team' of AAP, Congress: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta
india6.description: Rekha Gupta asserted the Party would fight resolutely against politics that spreads anarchy under the guise of democracy and challenges the public mandate

india6.title: Officials crack down on 203 network hospitals for various irregularities
india6.description: The NTR Vaidya Seva Trust imposed fines of ₹34.39 crore and took disciplinary action against 44 hospitals, including 25 suspensions, over the past two years

india6.title: Anti-CEC protest in Delhi top developments: detentions, curbs, crackdown
india6.description: Security forces in Delhi detained more than 3,300 people and barred access to Jantar Mantar on Saturday, October 10, 2026, as authorities imposed a massive lockdown to stifle protests called by the Cockroach Janata Party and allied groups demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyan

india6.title: ‘Will come back tomorrow’: youth groups vow to continue protest till Gyanesh Kumar resigns
india6.description: CJP, Left Student organisations allege crackdown on protesters; demand rollback of SIR and resignation of CEC

india6.title: Delhi protest: Four men claiming links to Hindu Raksha Dal arrested for assault on students
india6.description: The accused have been identified as Raman Saini, 50, Vivekanand alias Vivek, 32, Kapil Kumar, 27, and Ravinder Singh alias Govind Hindu, 35, a senior police officer said

india6.title: Musk accuses Ambani's online supporters of 'absurd hypocrisy', `ridiculous arguments'
india6.description: The reality is that competition would greatly benefit the average citizen in India by giving them more choices, as it always does,says Elon Musk

india6.title: Karnataka CM Shivakumar, Congress legislators to join Delhi protest against SIR on Oct. 12
india6.description: Asked whether the Congress was supporting the protest by the CJP, Mr. Shivakumar said the party was taking its own course of action, while some INDIA bloc allies had participated in the other protest

india6.title: India condemns attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh
india6.description: The Ministry of External Affairs called the October 10 attack, which killed 12 and injured over 300, “completely unacceptable,” as Saudi Arabia blamed Houthi militants

india6.title: Uttar Pradesh receives investment intends worth over ₹695 crores in Dairy sector
india6.description: The Dairy Department provided investors with information regarding the investment opportunities available for the development of the Dairy sector in the state, departmental schemes and the procedures required for implementation of projects

india6.title: Mann slams Delhi Police’s ‘Taliban-like’ attitude over video of cops with shoes inside Bangla Sahib
india6.description: A controversy had erupted over Delhi police personnel allegedly entering the gurdwara premises in Delhi on Saturday as some protesters, facing police action during demonstrations against the Chief Election Commissioner, sought refuge there.

india6.title: A.P. Finance Minister Keshav urges Union Minister Gadkari to build bypasses on NH-42
india6.description: Payyavula Keshav met Nitin Gadkari in New Delhi and submitted a formal request for the works. The Union Minister has accorded in-principle approval for the proposals, said an official release.

india6.title: Tushar Gandhi among 12 named in FIR over Mumbai protest; 600 detained and released
india6.description: The protest was organised by Hum Bharat Ke Log in solidarity with CJP and Left groups’ protest in Delhi, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and others

india6.title: Reading habit is the foundation for personality development: Former Vice-Chancellor Hanumanthu Lajapathirai
india6.description: Dr. Hanumanthu Lajapathirai, honorary president of the Vizianagaram Reads Community, urges parents to encourage early reading habits in children

india6.title: Former Japanese PM’s wife Akie Abe meets RSS general secretary Dattatreya Hosabale
india6.description: A communique issued by the RSS said the meeting focused on ways to strengthen India–Japan relations, with particular emphasis on civilisational ties, cultural cooperation and people-centric initiatives.

india6.title: Three youth killed as speeding car crashes into bike in Kochi, driver booked
india6.description: The deceased are Eyas of Coorg in Karnataka, Gopika from Mannarkkad in Palakkad, and Devika from Wayanad. They were employees of an antique shop in Thrikkakara

india6.title: At 100, P.B. Menon has no retirement plans. He has court
india6.description: For P. B. Menon, a lawyer’s worth has never been determined by the number of years spent in court or the number of cases handled. What matters is the trust clients place in him and the responsibility that comes with representing them

india6.title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
india6.description: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh appealed for restraint after fresh clashes between Kuki and Naga armed groups killed nine people in Kamjong, Ukhrul and Kangpokpi districts

india6.title: Karnataka seeks wider price caps beyond cancer medicines on other high-cost life-saving drugs
india6.description: Health Minister U.T. Khader said price rationalisation should translate into direct savings for patients, and urged the Union government to extend similar measures to other essential medicines where high treatment costs place a burden on patients.

india6.title: Kidwai’s home-based palliative care in Karnataka reaches over 3,000 patients and caregivers
india6.description: On World Hospice and Palliative Care Day, Kidwai institute highlights home visits and bereavement support for families dealing with life-limiting illnesses

india6.title: Shigella cases ring alarm bells in Thrissur as 10 infections surface in nine days
india6.description: Tholur accounts for seven cases; all patients out of danger, says DMO; 39 dengue and four leptospirosis cases also reported in October

india6.title: Berlin to BITS Pilani: How Nobel-winning Optogenetics connects to parasite research in Hyderabad
india6.description: Light has become more than a means of observation; it is a way to intervene, test, and uncover cause-and-effect relationships, said Nishith Gupta, professor of Biological Sciences at BITS Pilan

india6.title: SIR protest: Former Bengaluru top cop and BJP leader Bhaskar Rao seeks verification of Dhruv Rathee’s citizenship, visa conditions
india6.description: Ex cop and BJP leader Rao has requested Home Secretary for a thorough verification of Dhruv Rathee’s nationality

india6.title: All 22 Indian crew rescued and safe after incident off UAE coast, Consulate says
Parliamentary panel indicts NTA; hope ‘arrogant’ Modi government takes it seriously: Congress
india6.description: Jairam Ramesh said a Parliamentary Standing Committee report catalogued “grave incompetence and malpractice” in the NTA, alleging nine paper leaks and a revenue surplus of ₹590 crore left unused for students

india6.title: SITAM Director says Ratan Tata Innovation Hub initiatives encourage students to develop new ideas
india6.description: In association with RTIH, the college organised the Vizianagaram district-level Ideathon under the Rasthriya Innovation Challenge-2026 for the last three days.

india7.title: CJP leaders Dipke, Ranka, Das released with 1-year condition to 'maintain peace'
india7.description: Cockroach Janata Party leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das were released on fifty thousand rupee bonds by a Delhi court after being preventively detained ahead of a planned protest.

india7.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released by Delhi Police after detention
india7.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was released late Saturday after being detained in Gurugram amid Delhi Police crackdowns on a protest demanding the Chief Election Commissioner 's resignation, though further legal action remains possible.

india7.title: Houthi attack on Saudi airport kills 12, over 300 wounded
india7.description: An airport attack in Riyadh killed 12 people and wounded 309, marking a deadly escalation by Iran-backed Houthis. The civil aviation authority temporarily suspended operations, while the Saudi-led coalition vowed to respond.

india7.title: SFI, DYFI, AISF activists detained during protest march in Delhi; CJP supporters join
india7.description: Following widespread detentions and traffic disruptions, the Cockroach Janata Party announced a fresh protest at New Delhi ‘s Jantar Mantar demanding the Chief Election Commissioner ‘s resignation over alleged electoral roll irregularities.

india7.title: Press bodies condemn detention of journalists during Delhi protests, demand apology
india7.description: Four Indian journalists' organisations condemned Delhi Police for allegedly detaining reporters covering protests, seizing equipment, and dismissing press cards, demanding an unconditional release, returned devices, a public apology, and a formal inquiry.

india7.title: UN expresses concern over mass detentions at Delhi protests; India calls remarks ‘misplaced’
india7.description: India rejected UN concerns regarding mass protest detentions in New Delhi as unwarranted interference, asserting that its democratic institutions lawfully safeguard peaceful assembly and public order amid ongoing demonstrations.

india7.title: Jantar Mantar out of reach, CJP protesters scatter across Delhi
india7.description: Heavy security across Delhi forced thousands of Cockroach Janta Party protesters into scattered demonstrations demanding the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation over alleged voter manipulation, resulting in at least 3,000 detentions without violence.

india7.title: BJP calls CJP protest a 'flop show', accuses Opposition of fomenting anarchy
india7.description: The BJP dismissed opposition protests in Delhi as a 'flop show', accusing Rahul Gandhi of conspiring with foreign powers to incite unrest and achieve power through 'mobocracy' rather than democratic elections.

india7.title: ‘Arrest us all’: Rahul Gandhi challenges Modi, urges youth to keep protesting
india7.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi urged youth to keep protesting and vowed to defeat Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government, accusing it of attacking the Constitution and labelling its leaders as cowards.

india7.title: Abhijeet Dipke's grandmother dies hours after CJP founder detained in Delhi
india7.description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke's grandmother, Savitribai Dipke, passed away at the age of 85 in Maharashtra.

malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി ∙ സമരങ്ങൾ രാജ്യതലസ്ഥാനത്തെ സംഘർഷഭരിതമാക്കിയിരിക്കെ, സുപ്രീം കോടതി പ്രത്യേക സിറ്റിങ് നടത്തി. സർക്കാരിനെ മറികടന്ന് ക്രമസമാധാനം നടപ്പിലാക്കരുതെന്ന് കോടതി നിർദേശിച്ചു. പ്രതിഷേധം നിയന്ത്രിക്കാൻ പൗര സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യം തടയരുത്. മെട്രോ സാധാരണപോലെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കണം. ഇന്റർനെറ്റ് നിരോധിക്കരുതെന്നും കോടതി നിർദ

malay2.title: ‘എന്താണ് നടപടിക്രമം, ആരാണ് അനുമതി നൽകിയത്?’: വിമാനത്തിലെ പൊലീസ് ആക്ഷനിൽ ചോദ്യവുമായി എയർ ഇന്ത്യ
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി∙ വിമാനത്തിനുള്ളിൽ കയറി കോക്രോച്ച് ജനതാ പാർട്ടി സ്ഥാപകൻ അഭിജിത് ദീപ്കെ ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്ളവരെ കസ്റ്റഡിയിലെടുത്ത സംഭവത്തിൽ എയർ ഇന്ത്യയ്ക്ക് അതൃപ്തി. വിമാനത്തിനകത്ത് സുരക്ഷാ ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥർ കയറാനിടയായ സാഹചര്യം വ്യക്തമാക്കണമെന്ന് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് ബ്യുറോ ഓഫ് സിവിൽ ഏവിയേഷൻ സെക്യൂരിറ്റിക്ക് എയർ ഇന്ത്യ കത്തു നൽക

malay2.title: പശ്ചിമേഷ്യൻ സംഘർഷം: കൊച്ചിയിൽനിന്നുള്ള 10 വിമാനങ്ങൾ റദ്ദാക്കി
malay2.description: കൊച്ചി ∙ ഗൾഫ് മേഖലയിലെ സംഘർഷ സാഹചര്യങ്ങൾ കണക്കിലെടുത്ത് കൊച്ചിയിൽനിന്ന് സൗദി അറേബ്യ ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്ള രാജ്യങ്ങളിലേക്കും തിരിച്ചുമുള്ള 10 വിമാന സർവീസുകൾ റദ്ദാക്കി. ഒക്ടോബർ 11, 12, 13 തീയതികളിലുള്ള സർവീസുകളാണ് റദ്ദാക്കിയതെന്ന് സിയാൽ അധികൃതർ അറിയിച്ചു. റദ്ദാക്കിയതിൽ ദോഹ, റാസൽഖൈമ എന്നിവിടങ്ങളിലേക്കുള്ള സർ

malay2.title: മദ്യപിച്ചിരുന്നെന്ന് സുഹൈലിന്റെ മൊഴി, വാഹനമെത്തിയത് അമിതവേഗത്തിൽ; മുൻപ് 218 കിലോമീറ്റർ വേഗത്തിൽ കാറോടിച്ചു
malay2.description: കൊച്ചി∙ നെടുമ്പാശേരിയിൽ 3 പേരുടെ മരണത്തിനിടയാക്കിയ ആഡംബര കാർ ഓടിച്ച സുഹൈൽ പതിവായി അമിത വേഗത്തിലാണ് കാർ ഓടിച്ചിരുന്നതെന്ന് പൊലീസ്. സുഹൈൽ‍ മുൻപ് 218 കിലോമീറ്റർ വേഗത്തിൽ വാഹനമോടിച്ചതിന്റെ വിഡിയോ ഇന്‍സ്റ്റഗ്രാം അക്കൗണ്ടിൽ പങ്കുവച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. വസ്ത്ര വ്യാപാരിയുടെ മകനായ സുഹൈൽ രാജഗിരി കോളജിലെ ബികോം വിദ്യാർഥ

malay2.title: കൊല്ലത്ത് പാർക്കിൻസൺസ് രോഗിയായ ഭർത്താവിനെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തി; ഭാര്യ ചെന്നൈയിൽ പിടിയിൽ
malay2.description: ശാസ്താംകോട്ട ∙പാർക്കിൻസൺസ് രോഗം ബാധിച്ച ഭർത്താവിനെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയ കേസിൽ ഭാര്യ അറസ്റ്റിൽ. പോരുവഴി ചാത്താകുളം ജിജി ഭവനിൽ ജോസ് ഡാനിയേൽ (അലക്സ്– 64) കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട സംഭവത്തിലാണ് ഭാര്യ മറിയാമ്മ ജോസിനെ (59) കഴിഞ്ഞ ദിവസം ചെന്നൈയിൽ നിന്നു പൊലീസ് അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തത്. പൊലീസ് പറയുന്നത്: കഴിഞ്ഞ 20നു രാവിലെയാണ് ജോസിനെ

malay2.title: ‘ഞാൻ മോദി ഭക്ത, ബിജെപിയിൽനിന്ന് രാജിവയ്ക്കില്ല, മരിക്കുംവരെ പാർട്ടിയിൽ തുടരും’
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം∙ ബിജെപിയിൽനിന്ന് രാജിവച്ചിട്ടില്ലെന്നും മരിക്കുംവരെ ബിജെപിയുടെ അഭിമാനമുള്ള അംഗമായി തുടരുമെന്നും മുൻ ഡിജിപിയും കോർപറേഷൻ കൗൺസിലറുമായ ആർ.ശ്രീലേഖ. തന്നെ ചിലർ മോശക്കാരിയാക്കാന്‍ ശ്രമിച്ചെന്നു യുട്യുബ് ചാനലിൽ ശ്രീലേഖ പറ‍ഞ്ഞു.

malay2.title: സിനിമാ തിയറ്ററുകളിൽ മിന്നൽ പരിശോധന; 26 കേസുകളെടുത്തു; 62,000 രൂപ പിഴ
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ സംസ്ഥാനത്തു സിനിമ തിയറ്ററുകളിൽ ലീഗൽ മെട്രോളജി, ഭക്ഷ്യസുരക്ഷാ, സിവിൽ സപ്ലൈസ് വകുപ്പുകൾ നടത്തിയ സംയുക്ത മിന്നൽ പരിശോധനയിൽ 26 കേസുകൾ റജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്തു. 5 തിയറ്ററുകൾക്കു കാരണം കാണിക്കൽ നോട്ടിസ് നൽകി. പിഴയായി 62,000 രൂപയും ചുമത്തി. തിയറ്ററുകളിൽ ശുദ്ധജലം ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നില്ലെന്നും അമിതവില ഈടാക

malay2.title: നെടുമ്പാശേരിയിൽ ആഡംബര കാറും ബൈക്കും കൂട്ടിയിടിച്ച് 3 മരണം; ‘എല്ലാം വീട്ടുകാർ നോക്കുമെന്ന്’ ഡ്രൈവറുടെ വെല്ലുവിളി
malay2.description: കൊച്ചി∙ നെടുമ്പാശേരി അത്താണിയിൽ കാറും ബൈക്കും കൂട്ടിയിടിച്ച് 3 പേർ മരിച്ചു. സ്കൂട്ടർ യാത്രക്കാരായ രണ്ട് യുവതികളും യുവാവുമാണ് മരിച്ചത്. വയനാട് മടക്കിമല സന്തോഷ് ഭവനിൽ ദേവിക (21), മംഗലാപുരം സുള്ള്യ കനകമഞ്ചൽ ഇബ്രാഹിമിന്റെ മകൻ ഇജാസ് (21), പാലക്കാട് കരിമ്പ ഇടക്കുറിശ്ശി മുള്ളൻകുഴി പ്രദീപ് കുമാറിന്റെ മകൾ ഗോ

malay2.title: ‘പണം വാങ്ങിയവർ അവനെ ചതിച്ചു, അപായപ്പെടുത്തി’: അന്വേഷണം അട്ടിമറിക്കാൻ പൊലീസും കൂട്ടുനിന്നെന്ന് മാതാപിതാക്കൾ
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ വയലിനിസ്റ്റ് ബാലഭാസ്കറിന്റെ മരണത്തിനു പിന്നിലെ യാഥാർഥ്യങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തി കുറ്റവാളികൾക്കു ശിക്ഷ ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നതുവരെ നിയമപോരാട്ടം തുടരുമെന്ന് മാതാപിതാക്കൾ. മകന്റെ മരണത്തിലെ അന്വേഷണം അട്ടിമറിക്കാൻ പ്രതികൾക്കൊപ്പം പൊലീസുകാരും കൂട്ടുനിന്നു. ഇതുസംബന്ധിച്ച തങ്ങളുടെ ആശങ്കകളും സംശയങ്ങളും ശരിയാണെന

malay2.title: കൊണാട്ട് പ്ലേസില്‍ വൻ സംഘർഷം: പ്രതിഷേധക്കാരെ വലിച്ചിഴച്ച് പൊലീസ്; ജെയ്ക്ക് അറസ്റ്റിൽ, ആദർശിന് പരുക്ക്
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി∙ രാജ്യതലസ്ഥാനത്ത് ഇന്നും ശക്തമായ പ്രതിഷേധം. മുഖ്യ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് കമ്മിഷണർ രാജി വയ്ക്കണം എന്നാവശ്യപ്പെട്ട് സിജെപിയും ഇടതു സംഘടനകളുമാണ് കൊണാട്ട് പ്ലേസിൽ പ്രതിഷേധിക്കുന്നത്. ജന്തർ മന്തറിൽനിന്ന് 200 മീറ്റർ അകലെയാണിത്. റോഡിൽ കുത്തിയിരുന്ന് പ്രതിഷേധിച്ച വിദ്യാർഥികളെ കേന്ദ്രസേനയും പൊലീസും വലിച്ചിഴച

japan1.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
japan1.description: 生成AIの「ChatGPT」の開発を手がけるアメリカのオープンAIは、AIモデル「アストラ」の開発の一時中断を7日、発表しました。理由について、AIの能力が大幅に向上し、みずからの判断で重大なサイバー攻撃を実行するおそれが排除できないとしています。

japan1.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請
japan1.description: SNS上で有名人の写真などを無断で使った「なりすまし広告」による詐欺の被害が相次ぐなか、政府は、SNSの運営事業者に対して、広告主の本人確認といった対策を強化するよう文書で要請しました。

japan1.title: 千葉 銚子 輸入サバ高騰で加工業者の約2割が倒産や廃業状態に
japan1.description: サバの加工が盛んな千葉県銚子市では、原料の大半を占めるノルウェー産などの輸入サバの価格高騰で水産加工業者の採算が悪化し、およそ2割が倒産や、事実上の廃業状態にあることが分かりました。

japan1.title: KDDI 楽天への回線提供の契約 9月で終了 一部では提供継続
japan1.description: KDDIが楽天モバイルに回線を貸し出す「ローミング契約」について、KDDIの松田浩路社長は、決算会見で、現在の契約は9月末で終了するものの、過疎地などエリアを限定して通信回線の提供を続ける考えを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: 米就業者 市場予想に反し減少 利上げ観測後退で円高ドル安進む
japan1.description: 円相場や株価に影響を及ぼすアメリカの雇用統計が発表され、7月の農業分野以外の就業者は減少に転じ、市場の予想を大幅に下回りました。アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会が早期に利上げに踏み切るという観測がいくぶん後退し、外国為替市場では、公表後にドルを売って円を買う動きが進みました。

japan1.title: 石油元売りに新交付金案 原油の代替調達促す 経産省会合で
japan1.description: 原油の調達先を多角化するため、石油元売り会社がホルムズ海峡をはじめリスクの高いルートを避けて調達する場合、会社に対して交付金を支給するという案が7日に開かれた経済産業省の会合で新たに示されました。

japan1.title: 東芝 最終利益4兆4000億円余 キオクシアHD株の評価益などで
japan1.description: 株式を非上場化して経営の立て直しを進めている東芝は、ことし4月から6月までの決算を発表し、株式を保有する半導体大手、キオクシアホールディングスの評価益などの影響で、最終的な利益が前の年の同じ時期のおよそ30倍となる4兆4000億円余りとなりました。

japan1.title: NY外国為替市場 円高ドル安が進む 米雇用統計発表受け
japan1.description: 7日のニューヨーク外国為替市場では、アメリカの雇用統計の発表を受けて、労働市場が減速しているという受け止めからドルを売って円を買う動きが強まりました。発表前、円相場は1ドル＝158円台前半で推移していましたが、一時、1ドル＝156円台後半まで1円以上、円高ドル安が進みました。

japan1.title: 食料自給率37％ 過去最低に コメの価格高騰が低下招く
japan1.description: 昨年度のカロリーベースの食料自給率は、前の年度より1ポイント下がって37％と過去最低になりました。価格高騰でコメの消費が減ったことが大きく響きました。

japan1.title: 食料品の消費税減税 ねらいは カギを握る片山財務相に聞く
japan1.description: 暮らしに関わる食料品の消費税減税。カギを握る片山財務大臣が閣議決定後、NHKのインタビューに応じました。財源は確保できるのか。足元の財務省内に反対論はないのか。ニュースウオッチ9の広内キャスターが直撃しました。

japan1.title: ビール大手3社 中間決算 各社売り上げ増 国内のビール販売好調
japan1.description: 大手ビールメーカー3社のことし上半期の決算は、国内のビール販売が好調だったことなどから、いずれも売り上げが伸び、このうち2社では、この時期として過去最高となりました。

japan1.title: 円相場 値下がり 米雇用統計発表控え様子見の投資家も
japan1.description: 7日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はドルに対して値下がりしました。

japan1.title: シャープ イラン情勢と円安で業績予想を下方修正
japan1.description: 大手電機メーカーの「シャープ」は、イラン情勢や円安の影響による原材料や燃料価格の高騰で、今年度の業績予想を下方修正し、最終的な利益が、当初の予想から40％余り減少するとの見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: ニチレイ サイバー攻撃影響などで売り上げ50億円減少の見通し
japan1.description: 冷凍食品大手のニチレイは、サイバー攻撃によるシステム障害で倉庫からの出庫業務が一時停止したことなどによる売り上げの減少が、通期で50億円にのぼるという見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: スーパーのコメ平均価格 5キロ3198円 6週連続で値下がり
japan1.description: 全国のスーパーで今月2日までの1週間に販売されたコメの平均価格は、5キロあたり税込み3198円と、前の週より100円以上、下がりました。値下がりは6週連続で、およそ1年10か月ぶりの水準です。

japan1.title: 秋田市に日本最大級のデータセンター整備計画
japan1.description: AI向けのデータセンターの需要が急速に高まる中、秋田市のIT企業がアメリカの企業と共同で市内に日本で最大級のデータセンターの整備を計画していることがわかりました。会社では整備費について2兆円以上を見込んでいて、UAE＝アラブ首長国連邦の政府系ファンドからの投資の受け入れに向けて協議を進めるとしています。

japan1.title: 公的年金積立金運用実績 四半期として過去最高の黒字 GPIF
japan1.description: 公的年金の積立金を運用しているGPIF＝年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人は、ことし4月から6月までの運用実績が24兆円余りの黒字で、四半期としては過去最高になったと発表しました。

japan1.title: 6月景気動向指数が上昇 景気の基調判断「改善」を維持 内閣府
japan1.description: ことし6月の景気動向指数は、景気の現状を示す「一致指数」が118.2と、前の月を0.3ポイント上回り、内閣府は「改善を示している」という景気の基調判断を維持しました。

japan1.title: 中国 7月の輸出額23％余増加 半導体やEVがけん引
japan1.description: 中国の先月の輸出額は、去年の同じ月と比べて23％余り増えました。半導体やEV＝電気自動車の輸出が増えたことが主な要因で、内需が停滞する中、輸出は好調な状況が続いていて経済を下支えしています。

japan1.title: 株価 小幅に値下がり
japan1.description: 7日の東京株式市場、日経平均株価は小幅に値下がりしました。

japan1.title: 土地取得ルール「届け出必要な対象拡大を」国交省の有識者会議
japan1.description: 不適切な土地の利用による住民とのトラブルなどを防ぐため、国土交通省の有識者会議は土地を取得する際に届け出が必要となる対象を広げるべきなどとする提言をまとめました。

japan1.title: 4月-6月決算ピーク イラン情勢の不透明感後退で上方修正相次ぐ
japan1.description: 上場企業のことし4月から6月の決算発表がピークを迎え、原油の先物価格が一時期より下落していることなどから今年度の業績見通しを上方修正する企業が相次いでいます。

japan1.title: 食料自給率 過去最低 ここにも“米騒動”の影響が【Q＆A】
japan1.description: 7日発表された昨年度のカロリーベースの食料自給率は37％。2020年度などとならんで過去最低の数字です。この落ち込みにも影を落としているのが、おととし以降のコメ価格の高騰だといいます。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 8月7日(金) 春の原油価格上昇 物価押し上げへ
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 米 半導体や太陽光パネルの材料に追加関税 中国を念頭か
japan1.description: アメリカのトランプ大統領は、半導体や太陽光パネルの主な材料となる「ポリシリコン」やその派生品に追加関税などを課す文書に署名しました。この材料の生産で高いシェアを占める中国を念頭にした措置とみられます。

japan1.title: 6月家計調査 7か月連続で減少 台風や梅雨で幅広く支出が減少
japan1.description: ことし6月に2人以上の世帯が消費に使った金額は、物価の変動を除いた実質で前の年の同じ月と比べて3.3％減少しました。台風や梅雨による天候不順などの影響で、食料や衣料品などさまざまな支出が減りました。

japan1.title: 4月30日の市場介入 6兆円余 円買いとして1日あたりで過去最大
japan1.description: 政府・日銀がことし4月30日に加え、大型連休中の5月4日と6日に市場介入を行ったことが分かりました。

japan1.title: アメリカの原油輸出減少 代替調達進める日本にも影響可能性も
japan1.description: 中東情勢を受けて、日本にとって原油の代替調達先としてアメリカの重要性が増す中、ことし6月のアメリカからの原油の輸出が前の月と比べて減少に転じました。今後もこうした傾向が続けば日本の原油調達に影響が及ぶ可能性もあり、アメリカの輸出動向が注目されます。

japan1.title: 大手企業の夏のボーナス初の100万円超 経団連最終集計
japan1.description: 大手企業のこの夏のボーナスに関する経団連の最終集計がまとまり、従業員1人あたりの平均で104万円余りと、いまの方法で調査を始めた1981年以降で最も高くなり初めて100万円を超えました。

japan1.title: 経産省 日本製紙の煙突倒壊受け自家発事業者に報告求める通知
japan1.description: 先月28日の地震で、日本製紙の熊本県八代市にある工場の煙突が倒壊するなどして9人が死亡したことを受けて、経済産業省は自家用の火力発電設備の煙突を設置している全国の事業者に対し、煙突の管理状況などを確認して報告するよう求める通知を出しました。

japan2.title: Takaichi again in a bind as U.S. threatens to ‘end’ ICC
japan2.description: Japan, which hosts roughly 60,000 U.S. service members and depends on Washington for its security, will need to walk a fine line as it pushes back.

japan2.title: ‘Everyone is angry’: Okinawans fearful and frustrated after killing
japan2.description: The alleged murder by an American soldier has reignited controversy over the heavy U.S. military presence on the southern island.

japan2.title: Indonesia releases eight orangutans rescued from fires to protected forest
japan2.description: Indonesian authorities and YIARI rescued 46 orangutans from threats of fires between August and Friday.

japan2.title: Guardians beat White Sox to complete comeback and punch ticket to ALCS
japan2.description: Cleveland became the fourth team to win a best-of-five postseason series after losing the first two games at home.

japan2.title: NASCAR and IndyCar look to generate Formula One-type growth overseas
japan2.description: The US-based leagues have seen F1, owned by Liberty Media, expand more outside its European base in recent years, helping boost its popularity.

japan2.title: Newspaper subscription rate in Japan falls below 50% for first time
japan2.description: More people are getting their news from television programs and the internet.

japan2.title: Trump calls for replacing Zelenskyy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia
japan2.description: Zelenskyy, in some of his sharpest criticism yet of the White House, blasted Trump's deal with Putin to lift sanctions on Russian diesel.

japan2.title: Eliud Kipchoge wins first marathon since 2023
japan2.description: It was his first victory over the distance since Berlin in 2023 and part of his "World Tour" to raise funds for causes he believes in.

japan2.title: Rubio cites ‘necessity’ of U.S. sanctions on ICC in call with Japanese counterpart
japan2.description: The court's legislative body demanded "the immediate revocation" of the sanctions, urging "the international community to stand firm" in its defense.

japan2.title: 26% in Japan see U.S. as biggest threat to world peace: survey
japan2.description: The rate for the United States rose 9.3 percentage points from the previous fiscal 2025 survey. The figure stood at 6.6% in fiscal 2024.

japan2.title: People-loving Autumn is ready for a new home
japan2.description: Autumn is a very sweet beagle, a colorful chap with a penchant for play. And, he'll warm your heart no matter what the temperature.

japan2.title: Ronaldo suspended by Portugal FA after leaving camp and criticizing coach
japan2.description: The Portuguese Football Federation opened disciplinary proceedings against Ronaldo after he left camp following a miscommunication with coach Jorge Jesus.

japan2.title: Tomoka Nishiyama earns right to become shogi’s first female kishi player
japan2.description: Nishiyama, 31, who holds four titles in the joryu kishi system for women, could become the first female to compete in the top open system.

japan2.title: Trust in science falls as COVID-era confidence fades, global survey finds
japan2.description: The retreat has potentially far-reaching consequences for public health as vaccination rates decline and preventable diseases resurge.

japan2.title: Two die and 16 hurt in Osaka danjiri float festival accidents
japan2.description: The victims, both men, were crushed under floats that overturned when traveling on the road, according to the Osaka Prefectural Police department.

japan2.title: Hunger and malnutrition stalk Gazans, one year on from ceasefire
japan2.description: Every day, Niyaha al-Masri spends six exhausting hours or more queueing at a community kitchen in the hope of getting some food for her family.

japan2.title: Survivor of botched U.S. lethal injection returns to prison
japan2.description: Pike, 50, was given two doses of the drug pentobarbital on Sept. 30 — a usually fatal dose that nevertheless failed to kill her.

japan2.title: Nao-Cola Yamazaki is your favorite writer’s favorite writer
japan2.description: More than 20 years after their literary debut, two of Nao-Cola Yamazaki's books have finally appeared in English translation for the first time.

japan2.title: India detains thousands and locks down Delhi to foil election chief protest
japan2.description: Thousands of police and paramilitary personnel were deployed across the city.

japan2.title: Trump’s AI liability push opens blame game for models gone rogue
japan2.description: Further complicating any finding of responsibility, a model's behavior is shaped by both its AI developer and the end user deploying the system.

bd3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bd3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bd3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it

ca3.title: Could Quebec's new government derail plans for Alto's high-speed train project?
ca3.description: The Crown corporation responsible for a proposed high-speed rail line connecting Toronto to Quebec City says it plans to deliver on the project, despite opposition from the newly elected Parti Québécois (PQ) government.

ca3.title: How some separatists are responding to Smith’s pledge against 2nd referendum if remain vote wins
ca3.description: Premier Danielle Smith’s pledge that she won’t hold another referendum on separation if the remain vote wins this month — at least as long as she is premier — is getting pushback from some prominent Alberta separatists.

ca3.title: Age, speed limits for e-scooters and other personal electric vehicles hitting Manitoba roads next year
ca3.description: Riders must be at least 16 years old and anyone using the devices, including passengers, are required to wear properly fitting helmets, the province says. Personal electric vehicles can't go faster than 25 km/h under the incoming speed limit.

ca3.title: Residential school denialism shouldn't be illegal, Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says
ca3.description: Residential school denialism is detestable but not illegal, and that shouldn't change, says Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew, who disagrees with federal Manitoba NDPer Leah Gazan's efforts to add it to the Criminal Code.

ca3.title: Why this Fredericton woman is walking a Ukrainian battalion flag across P.E.I.
ca3.description: Julia Cardy will spend two weeks walking across Prince Edward Island with a flag her friend April Huggett carried for 700 kilometres in Ukraine. The journey is raising money for Ukrainian soldiers and bringing their stories closer to home.

ca3.title: A Newfoundlander got a random call from a bunch of Hollywood stars — and just went with it
ca3.description: Newfoundlander Paul Matthews picked up the phone last month, not knowing it was Jax Irwin on the other end. Irwin cold calls people on the east coast, just to chat. But that day, she had Hollywood star Josh Hartnett and the cast of a new Netflix show on the line with her.

ca3.title: ‘Every rock has a story’: retired geologist opens rock library in Whitehorse
ca3.description: Tucked away down a quiet street in Whitehorse is a new community library, with a geological twist. You won't find a new thriller, or a well-loved cookbook. The shelves aren’t filled with paper, they’re filled with rocks.

ca3.title: Man admits to 5 sex assaults near Winnipeg's Health Sciences Centre, including one against 14-year-old girl
ca3.description: A man charged in five sexual assaults near Winnipeg's Health Sciences Centre last summer has pleaded guilty. Donovan Mohammed sat quietly in the prisoner's box Friday, speaking briefly to confirm to his lawyer he was admitting guilt.

ca3.title: New church set to rise up after 'suspicious' fire in Kinngait, Nunavut
ca3.description: More than three years after a suspicious fire destroyed the Anglican church in Kinngait, Nunavut, work is well underway to begin building a new structure.

ca3.title: Woman who married ISIS fighter pleads guilty to terror-related charge
ca3.description: Kimberly Polman pleaded guilty on Thursday to leaving Canada to participate in activities of a terrorist group, namely the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria (ISIS).

ca3.title: After days of giving French-only answers in legislature, Kinew wants schools to cover '80s language battle
ca3.description: Manitoba's premier wants the province's schools to teach students about the intense public backlash to the expansion of francophone rights in the 1980s.

ca3.title: Ex-Marineland beluga whale dies in Chicago aquarium
ca3.description: Shedd Aquarium in Chicago says Caspian, a 27-year-old female beluga, died on Wednesday, becoming the sixth animal from the closed Ontario theme park Marineland to die after a massive relocation of whales and dolphins over the summer.

ca3.title: Alberta Court of Appeal says Ottawa's Impact Assessment Act is still unconstitutional
ca3.description: In a decision issued Friday, the court said that even though Ottawa modified the law after the Supreme Court struck down much of it in 2023, the new law still infringes on provincial jurisdiction.

ca3.title: Top court sets sentencing framework for cases involving Indigenous offenders, victims
ca3.description: The ruling comes in the case of a Mi'kmaw man with severe mental health challenges who was sentenced in Nova Scotia to five years in prison after pleading guilty to aggravated assault against his partner, a Mi'kmaw woman.

ca3.title: Fight for independence won't end after referendum: Alberta Prosperity Project leader
ca3.description: Albertans are being asked to pick whether to stay in Canada or hold an eventual vote on whether or not the province should leave the country.

ca3.title: 11 things we learned about Terry Fox from Run Terry Run
ca3.description: Run Terry Run, a new documentary directed by Sean Menard, offers a deeper look at Terry Fox beyond his status as one of Canada’s most celebrated heroes. The film draws from 96 reels of previously unseen footage from Fox's 1980 Marathon of Hope, and highlights his humour, frustrations and determinati

ca3.title: Police watchdog investigating after man injured during arrest on Sask. First Nation
ca3.description: The Serious Incident Response Team is investigating after a man was injured while RCMP were arresting him on Mosquito Grizzly Bear’s Head Lean Man First Nation. He was released with no charges.

ca3.title: Driscoll’s berries case raises questions about Canada’s food safety watchdog
ca3.description: Allegations of non-compliant pesticide levels on imported Driscoll’s berries have ignited a broader debate over Canada's food safety system. While the Canadian Food Inspection Agency defends its system , critics warn federal job cuts weaken protection against unsafe foreign food imports.

ca3.title: When Hammers star Brandon Scanlin told his mom he's coming home to play AHL hockey 'she almost started crying'
ca3.description: After years without professional hockey in Hamilton, the wait is almost over. The Hamilton Hammers will play their first regular-season home game Friday night, hosting the Toronto Marlies at TD Coliseum as the new AHL team begins its inaugural season.

ca3.title: Shell to buy 30% stake in proposed Bay du Nord oil project off Newfoundland
ca3.description: Equinor says it will retain a 70 per cent operating interest in the project, which would be the first deepwater oil development in Canada if it goes ahead.
